Split a domain into more entries as you test.

methodology: Grey-box testing following OWASP WSTG v4.2 and ASVS 5.0.0, with two tenants and three roles each, plus code and configuration review where access was granted. Process per NIST SP 800-115.
rulesOfEngagement: <signed authorization reference; environments; test windows; no DoS without a waiver; data handling; stop conditions; escalation contact>
summary: <three to five sentences a non-technical reader can act on>

coverage.test: External attack surface: subdomains, exposed storage, staging hosts, TLS and headers, internet-reachable admin panels
Authentication, SSO and MFA: lockout, MFA bypass, SAML signature wrapping, OIDC state/nonce/redirect URI, password reset tokens
Session management: entropy, rotation, server-side logout, cookie flags, fixation
Authorization and tenant isolation: every object ID swapped across tenants A and B for read, write and delete; role escalation; cross-tenant leaks via search, export and webhooks
API security: mass assignment, rate limits on costly operations, old and undocumented versions, CORS
Input handling: injection, stored and DOM XSS, uploads, XXE, path traversal, SSRF
Business logic: pricing and coupons, step skipping, races on limits and credits, plan abuse
Secrets and keys: secrets in repos, images, bundles and logs; rotation; separation by tenant and environment
Cloud configuration: IAM wildcards, public storage, exposed network rules, logging and encryption, admin MFA
CI/CD and supply chain: branch protection, provenance, pinned dependencies and actions, OIDC instead of static keys, signing
Logging, monitoring and IR: security events logged, log integrity, alert routing, credential-leak tabletop
Data protection: TLS and HSTS, encryption at rest and in backups, tenant deletion, retention vs. policy
Third parties, webhooks and OAuth apps: scopes, redirect URI and PKCE, token storage, webhook signatures and replay, revocation
AI and LLM features: prompt injection, tool permissions, prompt leakage, output into sinks, tenant isolation in retrieval
